title: The Payable Payment Gateway for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.3.1 does not verify the authenticity of an…
description: The Payable Payment Gateway for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions before 1.3.1 fails to verify the authenticity of incoming payment notifications. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to alter the payment status of any order in the store, regardless of the payment method used.
